items.headline: Special Marine Warning issued November 15 at 3:21PM CST until November 15 at 4:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX out 20 NM; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM
items.description:
SMWHGX

The National Weather Service in League City has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX out 20
NM...
Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM...
Galveston Bay...

* Until 400 PM CST.

* At 321 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Surfside Jetty, moving east at 20
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts to nearly 50 knots, and small
hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Drum Bay and Surfside Jetty.
items.instruction:
Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 15 at 11:03AM CST until November 16 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Chambers; Inland Jackson; Inland Matagorda; Inland Brazoria; Inland Galveston; Coastal Harris; Coastal Jackson; Coastal Matagorda; Coastal Brazoria; Coastal Galveston
items.description:
* WHAT...East to northeast winds 20 to 25 mph with gusts up to 35 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Jackson, Inland Jackson, Chambers, Coastal
Brazoria, Coastal Galveston, Coastal Harris, Coastal Matagorda,
Inland Brazoria, Inland Galveston, and Inland Matagorda Counties.

* WHEN...Until noon CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 15 at 11:08AM CST until November 16 at 6:00AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 25 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
extremely rough bay waters.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, until 6 AM CST Monday. For the
Small Craft Advisory, from 6 AM to 3 PM CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Heavy showers and thunderstorms likely
today. Cannot rule out locally higher winds and waterspouts.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
